name: Forliuzazco
backstory: Child of Forliauzco and Farliazco in Terfila; raised alongside walks the transit route between Terfila and the..., having heard only a half-remembered story about an old family death, long since thinned to gossip.

experience.text: Grew up hearing: Learned that Forliarlo has died.
Grew up hearing: Had a child with Forliauzco, named Farliauzco.
Grew up hearing: Heard that Tamuzco and Forliamuk now have a child, Tamuzaken.
Grew up hearing: Heard that Farlo and Trezco now have a child, Trezarlo.
Grew up hearing: Grew up hearing: Heard that Trezco and Tamuken now have a child, Tamuzco.
Grew up hearing: Learned that Forliukar has died.
Heard that Tamuzco and Farliazco now have a child, Farliuzco.
Heard that Tamuzco and Trezukar now have a child, Trezukuzco.
Heard that Tamuzarlo and Farliauzco now have a child, Farliauzar.
Heard that Trezukar and Tamuzaken now have a child, Tamuzakar.
Heard that Forliauzco and Farliazco now have a child, Farliazuzco.
Heard that Trezukar and Tamuzaken now have a child, Trezukaken.
Heard that Forliauzco and Farliukar now have a child, Forliaukarli.
Heard that Tamuzarlo and Farliauzco now have a child, Tamuzauzco.

criterion.standard: holds themself accountable to Birth Of Niergus, whatever it costs
criterion.wasted_life: one that never had to answer for Birth Of Niergus
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

routines.routine_actions: takes his turn unloading crates through the morning tide, bartering gossip for a cut rate at the tavern, and letting the tollhouse story drift a little further from however it started.
